projects.name: tinymachines.ai
projects.what: The front door, the documentation tree, the style guide and the roof's own API. Not a project in the sense the others are: it is the thing they arrive under.

surfaces.name: The main site
surfaces.what: The front page. Reached from the masthead rather than from the nav, because a nav entry for the page you are already on is noise.

surfaces.name: The documentation tree
surfaces.what: Markdown and MDX under docs/, with the navigation derived from the tree.

surfaces.name: The style guide
surfaces.what: The guide and the widget zoo, which is the normative set of specimens.

surfaces.name: Admin
surfaces.what: Dev keys and the people they belong to. Deliberately not in the navigation: that is not security, the key the API demands is, but it is not a page a reader has any use for.

surfaces.name: The roof API
surfaces.what: What the pieces are and which of them are answering, spoken as REST and as MCP.

projects.what: A transistor-level MOS 6502 traced from die photographs, and everything built on it: the explorer, the API over the real chip, the warm engine process and the console.

surfaces.name: The explorer
surfaces.what: The die itself, lit by what it is doing, plus the measured tables and the primer.

surfaces.name: The 6502 API
surfaces.what: Stateless HTTP over the real chip, with the registry on the same app and an MCP endpoint.

surfaces.name: Die Runner
surfaces.what: The console, the cartridge format, the builder pages and the registry that measures what it publishes. The console is here and dressed in the kit; /builders, /b/<handle> and /manage are still on the subdomain, because they read live registry data and moving them is tinymachines/6502#9 rather than a restyle.

surfaces.name: The halfwave lab
surfaces.what: A 6502, half a clock phase at a time. The R&D surface, and it stays R&D.

projects.name: hotbits
projects.what: The next project after 6502 settles. Nothing has been moved and nothing has been decided about it here beyond the fact that it is next.
